program: Proposed therapeutic tai chi fall-prevention course
scope: Proposed fidelity-specified 24-week TJQMBB course for high-fall-risk older adults. Not a valuation of the existing six-week Sun-style course.

judgments.label: Course planning allowance
judgments.basis: 48 classes × two paid preparation/delivery hours × $60 / 15 participants + $200 support = $584, rounded to $600. Assumed occupancy, wage and support—not a provider quote. Licensing, room and transport need pricing.

judgments.label: Hypothesized endpoint utility gain
judgments.basis: Independent calibration of .04, not a securely verified endpoint coefficient: Li/Harmer prose describes utility difference but its methods multiply by duration and table labels .04 incremental QALYs. Our duration/onset assumptions are not a correction to that paper.

judgments.label: Modeled follow-up horizon
judgments.basis: Rounded six-month horizon (0.5 year), not exactly 24/52 years. No persistence beyond follow-up.

judgments.label: Benefit onset over follow-up
judgments.basis: 50% assumes linear growth from zero to the hypothesized endpoint. Judgment, not adherence. No second attendance adjustment.

judgments.label: Local fidelity and population retention
judgments.basis: 50% subjective retention for proposed curriculum, high-risk recruitment and realistic local alternatives. Reference comparison is stretching, not no exercise or current Sun-style tai chi.

judgments.label: Additional funded capacity
judgments.basis: 50% assumed net added places after replacement funding. No verified current offer.

unitAmbiguity: If .04 is used directly as the paper's integrated QALYs, with the same cost/transfer/additionality and no extra duration/onset, the central price is $600,000 per 10 QALYs. Our independent endpoint bridge gives $2.4M. Neither is a measured local effect.
nullBoundary: Null or harm remains possible. The favorable/unfavorable combinations are analyst scenarios, not a confidence interval. No finite positive price exists at zero or negative benefit.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: Named curriculum and qualified instructors, high-risk eligibility, active cohort budget and post-March-2026 funding plan.

excluded: Additional fall-injury, mortality or healthcare-savings gains on top of health utility
Current six-week Sun-style service treated as the 24-week trial
Expired CalFresh closeout budget interpreted as current funding room
